    ascending: $ascending

f751908be074aa0bf4d1dd045535dd240d0474b9:
query FlxSocialStats($days: Int) {
  flxSocialStats(days: $days) {
    days
    lastMetrics {
      timestamp
    }
    totals {
      published
      failed
      scheduled
      pending
      drafts
      engagement
      views
      followers
      followersDelta
      successRate
    }
    byDay {
      day
      networks {
        provider
        count
      }
    }
    byNetwork {
      provider
      published
      failed
      engagement
      views
    }
    followers {
      accountId
      name
      provider
      avatar
      now
      delta
      series {
        day
        count
      }
    }
    top {
      targetId
      postId
      provider
      account
      title
      engagement
      views
      url
      at {
        timestamp
      }
    }
    upcoming {
      ...FlxSocialPostRow
    }
    errors {
      targetId
      postId
      account
      provider
      error
      at {
        timestamp
      }
    }
  }
}
